romo.name: Rocky Mountain
romo.tag: Tundra above the treeline, sixty peaks over twelve thousand feet
romo.hours: Open 24 h · Bear Lake Rd timed entry
romo.resNote: Bear Lake Road corridor permits (5 am–6 pm) sell out. Released on Recreation.gov the 1st of the month prior, 8 am MT; next-day permits at 5 pm MT.

wx.note: Storms build over the divide by early afternoon — be off Trail Ridge before 1 pm.

gates: Beaver Meadows — US-36 from Estes Park (main)
Fall River — US-34, best for Trail Ridge
romo.parking: Bear Lake and Glacier Gorge lots fill before 6 am. Park at the Park & Ride and take the shuttle.

lodging.name: The Stanley Hotel
lodging.note: The one with the hedge maze

slow: L2 at the Stanley and the visitor centre

alerts.title: Timed-entry permit in effect
alerts.body: Bear Lake Road corridor needs a permit 5 am–6 pm through 20 October. Rest of the park 9 am–2 pm.

alerts.title: Elk rut begins
alerts.body: Bulls are aggressive in Moraine Park at dusk. Stay 75 ft back; do not walk between a bull and his harem.

items.text: Enter before permit hours; park at Glacier Gorge
Emerald Lake chain — Nymph, Dream, Emerald (3.6 mi)
Shuttle down, breakfast at the Egg of Estes
Sprague Lake flat loop, then elk at Moraine Park
Drive Trail Ridge west — Many Parks Curve, Rainbow Curve
Alpine Visitor Center (11,796 ft) — walk Alpine Ridge
Milner Pass and the Continental Divide sign
Down before the storms; Estes Park brewery

arch.name: Arches
arch.tag: Two thousand stone arches over red slickrock desert
arch.resNote: Timed-entry ticket required 7 am–4 pm through 31 October. $2 on Recreation.gov; releases a month ahead, next-day tickets at 7 pm MT.

wx.note: Monsoon cells build after noon. Hike before 10 am and carry a gallon per person.

gates: Main entrance — US-191, 5 mi north of Moab (the only gate)
arch.parking: Devils Garden, Delicate Arch and the Windows fill by 8 am. Enter before 7 am or after 3 pm.

slow: L2 at Hyatt Place, Hoodoo, Field Station

alerts.title: Timed entry in effect
alerts.body: Vehicles need a ticket 7 am–4 pm through 31 October. Without one: enter before 7 am or after 4 pm.

alerts.title: Extreme heat advisory
alerts.body: Highs near 100°F. Delicate Arch trail has no shade and no water.

items.text: Enter before ticket hours; drive the scenic road while it is cool
Devils Garden — Landscape Arch, on to Double O if energetic
Siesta in Moab — Sweet Cravings, galleries on Main St
Delicate Arch (3 mi) for golden hour; headlamp for the walk down
Sunrise at the Windows — Turret Arch through North Window
Double Arch, then Balanced Rock
Park Avenue walk before the heat
Panorama Point, dinner at Desert Bistro

stamps.name: Canyonlands NP — Island in the Sky

zion.name: Zion
zion.tag: A slot canyon you walk up, with a river for a floor
zion.hours: Open 24 h · canyon shuttle 6 am–8 pm
zion.resNote: No entry reservation. Angels Landing needs a lottery permit — the day-before draw closes at 3 pm MT.

wx.note: Flash-flood risk in the Narrows. Check the day’s rating at the visitor centre each morning.

gates: South entrance — Springdale (shuttle only into the canyon)
East entrance — Mt Carmel, SR-9 tunnel
zion.parking: The main lot is full by 7:30 am. Park in Springdale and walk in over the footbridge.

lodging.name: Zion Lodge
lodging.note: The only beds inside the canyon

lodging.name: Desert Pearl Inn
lodging.note: River-side; 6 min walk to the gate

slow: L2 at Desert Pearl, Cable Mountain Lodge

alerts.title: Flash-flood watch — the Narrows
alerts.body: Probable rating on Wednesday. Rangers may close the Narrows and Orderville with no notice.

alerts.title: Angels Landing by lottery only
alerts.body: Day-before lottery opens at 12:01 am and closes 3 pm MT for the next day. $6 to apply.

items.text: First shuttle from the visitor centre — beat the canyon crowd
Temple of Sinawava → walk the Narrows to Wall Street
Dry off; lunch at the Spotted Dog in Springdale
Pa’rus Trail at dusk — paved, easy, deer everywhere
Watchman Trail before the sun clears the east rim
Emerald Pools, lower to upper
Drive the Mt Carmel tunnel to Checkerboard Mesa
Canyon Junction bridge for the last light on the Watchman

grte.name: Grand Teton
grte.tag: A granite rampart rising seven thousand feet off the valley floor
grte.resNote: No entry reservation. Jenny Lake shuttle and Snake River floats sell out weeks ahead.

wx.note: Cold mornings, afternoon thunder over the range. Pack layers.

grte.parking: Jenny Lake and Lupine Meadows full by 9 am.

camping.name: Jenny Lake Campground
camping.status: The hardest booking in the park

alerts.title: Food storage required
alerts.body: Grizzlies frequent Jenny Lake and Cascade Canyon. Carry spray; use the lockers.

items.text: First boat → Hidden Falls, Inspiration Point
On into Cascade Canyon — moose habitat
Sunset from Signal Mountain

yell.name: Yellowstone
yell.tag: A supervolcano with a plumbing problem, and wolves
yell.resNote: No entry reservation. In-park lodging opens 13 months ahead and goes in a day.

wx.note: Frost possible at dawn in the Lamar Valley even in August.

yell.parking: Midway Geyser Basin and Grand Prismatic fill 9 am–4 pm.

alerts.title: Stay on the boardwalks
alerts.body: Thermal ground is thin crust over boiling water. Every year someone learns this the hard way.

items.text: Old Faithful at first light, no crowd
Grand Prismatic overlook from Fairy Falls trail
Lamar Valley for wolves at dusk

glac.name: Glacier
glac.tag: Going-to-the-Sun Road, and twenty-five glaciers still holding on
glac.hours: Open 24 h · Logan Pass closes with snow
glac.resNote: Vehicle reservation required for Going-to-the-Sun Road 7 am–3 pm. Released 4 months ahead, plus next-day at 7 pm MT.

wx.note: Smoke haze is common in late August. Check air quality before long hikes.

glac.parking: Logan Pass full by 7:30 am; the shuttle is the sane choice.

slow: L2 at Apgar and Lake McDonald Lodge

alerts.title: Vehicle reservation required
alerts.body: Going-to-the-Sun Road needs a reservation 7 am–3 pm. Enter before 7 am without one.

items.text: Drive east before the reservation window
Highline Trail from Logan Pass
Lake McDonald pebbles at golden hour

olym.name: Olympic
olym.tag: Rainforest, alpine meadow and wild coast in one afternoon
olym.resNote: No reservation. Hurricane Ridge road closes on winter weekdays.

wx.note: Coastal fog burns off by mid-morning. Tide tables matter more than the forecast.

olym.parking: Hoh and Hurricane Ridge lots hold cars at capacity; go before 9 am.

alerts.title: Check the tide chart
alerts.body: Coastal headlands are impassable above a 4 ft tide. Rangers hand out charts free.

items.text: Hall of Mosses before the tour buses
Ruby Beach at low tide — sea stacks and driftwood
Second Beach sunset, 0.7 mi in

grca.name: Grand Canyon
grca.tag: A mile down, and the rock at the bottom is two billion years old
grca.hours: South Rim open 24 h all year
grca.resNote: No entry reservation. Phantom Ranch and corridor campgrounds go by lottery 15 months out.

wx.note: It is 20°F hotter at the river than on the rim. Do not hike down after 10 am.

grca.parking: Village lots fill 10 am–4 pm; the free shuttle covers everything.

lodging.name: El Tovar Hotel
lodging.note: 1905, and it shows in the best way

alerts.title: Inner canyon heat risk
alerts.body: Bright Angel below Havasupai Gardens exceeds 105°F. Rangers turn hikers back after 10 am.

items.text: Mather Point at sunrise, then the Rim Trail west
Bright Angel down to the 1.5-mile resthouse only
Hopi Point for sunset via the shuttle

LEGS.road: US-36 through Lyons and the Big Thompson canyon
ev: Lyons Supercharger — 8 stalls · 250 kW (top up before the climb)

LEGS.road: I-70 west over Vail Pass, US-191 south from Crescent Junction
US-191 to I-70, UT-24 past Capitol Reef, I-15 south

fly.note: Two hops and a rental swap. The drive wins.

LEGS.road: I-15 north to I-70 east — a long one

fly.note: Recommended. Drop the car in Las Vegas, 2 h 45 from Springdale.
